# Filling a Template

Filling a template generates a completed document by replacing all placeholder fields with real values.

## Steps

1. From the **Templates** list, click **Fill** on the template you want to use.
2. Optionally, use **Auto-fill from a matter or client** at the top of the modal to prefill placeholders like the client's name or a matter number automatically. See [Template Auto-Fill](/automation/documents-and-calendar#template-auto-fill).
3. Enter a value for each remaining placeholder field, listed one after another in the modal.
4. For any **repeating sections**, use the **+** button to add rows and fill in each row's fields. Use the trash icon on a row to remove it.
5. Use the eye icon to **preview** the filled document in a new tab before you commit to it.
6. Click **Download** and choose your output format, or **Save to Files** to file the completed document directly in your firm's file manager instead.

## Output Formats

| Format | Notes |
|---|---|
| **PDF** | Best for sending to clients or printing |
| **Word (DOCX)** | Editable in Microsoft Word |
| **ODT** | Open Document format |
| **RTF** | Compatible with most word processors |
| **TXT** | Plain text, no formatting |

## Tips

- Every field has to be filled in, including every row of a repeating section, before you can preview, download, or save the document. Paralegix tells you which fields are still empty if you try too early.
- The preview is not live: it renders the document in a new tab when you click the eye icon, so you can check formatting before you download. Nothing updates automatically as you type.
- Repeater rows are not reorderable. Add and remove rows, but the order you add them in is the order they appear in.
